eng110-01.stem: Tom is really a naughty boy. He likes to ＿＿＿＿ and play jokes on his younger sister when their parents are not around.
eng110-01.ex:
句意：Tom 真是個頑皮的男孩，爸媽不在時，他喜歡＿＿＿妹妹、對她惡作劇。

和 play jokes on 並列 → (C) tease 戲弄、取笑 ✓

(B) spare 饒恕、撥出（時間）（全國 15% 誤選）(A) alert 警告 (D) oppose 反對。
eng110-01.k: naughty（頑皮）、play jokes on（捉弄）→ 喜歡 tease（戲弄）妹妹。

eng110-02.stem: Elderly shoppers in this store are advised to take the elevator rather than the ＿＿＿＿ , which may move too fast for them to keep their balance.
eng110-02.ex:
句意：店裡建議年長的顧客搭電梯，不要搭＿＿＿，因為它可能移動得太快，讓他們站不穩。

→ (C) escalator 手扶梯 ✓

(A) airway 航線、呼吸道（全國 10% 誤選）(B) operator 操作員 (D) instrument 儀器、樂器。
eng110-02.k: 和 elevator（電梯）相對、會「移動得太快而站不穩」的是 escalator（手扶梯）。

eng110-03.stem: Upon hearing its master’s call, the dog wagged its tail, and followed her out of the room ＿＿＿＿ .
eng110-03.ex:
句意：一聽到主人的呼喚，狗搖著尾巴，＿＿＿跟著她走出房間。

→ (A) obediently 順從地 ✓

(B) apparently 顯然地（全國 17% 誤選）(D) thoroughly 徹底地（全國 16% 誤選）(C) logically 合乎邏輯地。
eng110-03.k: 聽到主人呼喚、搖尾巴跟著出去 → obediently（順從地）。

eng110-04.stem: Since many of our house plants are from humid jungle environments, they need ＿＿＿＿ air to keep them green and healthy.
eng110-04.ex:
句意：很多室內植物來自潮濕的叢林環境，所以需要＿＿＿空氣來保持翠綠健康。

humid 的同義字 → (A) moist 潮濕的 ✓

(D) fertile 肥沃的（全國 16% 誤選）：形容土地，不形容空氣。

(B) stale 不新鮮的（全國 10% 誤選）(C) crisp 清新乾爽的（全國 10% 誤選）。
eng110-04.k: 植物來自潮濕（humid）的叢林 → 需要 moist（濕潤的）空氣。

eng110-05.stem: The skydiver managed to land safely after jumping out of the aircraft, even though her ＿＿＿＿ failed to open in midair.
eng110-05.ex:
句意：雖然她的＿＿＿在半空中沒有打開，跳傘員跳出飛機後還是成功安全降落。

→ (D) parachute 降落傘 ✓

(C) segment 部分、片段（全國 22% 誤選）(B) latitude 緯度（全國 18% 誤選）(A) glimpse 一瞥（全國 13% 誤選）。
eng110-05.k: 跳傘員（skydiver）從飛機跳下，在空中沒打開的是 parachute（降落傘）。

eng110-06.stem: The invention of the steam engine, which was used to power heavy machines, brought about a ＿＿＿＿ change in society.
eng110-06.ex:
句意：用來驅動重型機器的蒸汽機，它的發明為社會帶來＿＿＿的改變。

→ (D) revolutionary 革命性的、徹底改變的 ✓

(C) conventional 傳統的（全國 22% 誤選）(B) harmonious 和諧的（全國 11% 誤選）(A) persuasive 有說服力的。
eng110-06.k: 蒸汽機帶動重型機器（工業革命）→ 帶來 revolutionary（革命性的）改變。

eng110-07.stem: To encourage classroom ＿＿＿＿ , the teacher divided the class into groups and asked them to solve a problem together with their partners.
eng110-07.ex:
句意：為了鼓勵課堂＿＿＿，老師把全班分組，要大家和組員一起解決問題。

→ (B) interaction 互動 ✓

(A) operation 運作、手術（全國 13% 誤選）(C) adjustment 調整（全國 11% 誤選）(D) explanation 解釋。
eng110-07.k: 分組、和夥伴一起解題 → 為了鼓勵課堂 interaction（互動）。

eng110-08.stem: Lisa ＿＿＿＿ onto the ground and injured her ankle while she was playing basketball yesterday.
eng110-08.ex:
句意：Lisa 昨天打籃球時＿＿＿在地上，弄傷了腳踝。

→ (D) tumbled 跌倒、摔倒 ✓

(B) punched 用拳頭打（全國 20% 誤選）(C) scattered 散落（全國 12% 誤選）(A) buried 埋葬。
eng110-08.k: tumble onto the ground＝跌倒在地；所以扭傷了腳踝。

eng110-09.stem: Hundreds of residents received free testing ＿＿＿＿ from the city government to find out if their water contained any harmful chemicals.
eng110-09.ex:
句意：數百位居民從市政府拿到免費的檢測＿＿＿，檢查家裡的水是否含有有害化學物質。

「拿到」可以自己用來檢測的東西 → (A) kits 成套的工具 ✓

(B) trials 試驗（全國 39% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：free trial 是「免費試用」，但 receive testing trials 不能表示拿到檢測工具。

(D) proofs 證據（全國 25% 誤選）(C) zones 區域（全國 13% 誤選）。
eng110-09.k: testing kit＝檢測套組（居民拿回家自己測水質）；trial 是試驗、試用期。

eng110-10.stem: The 2011 Nobel Peace Prize was awarded ＿＿＿＿ to three women for the efforts they made in fighting for women’s rights.
eng110-10.ex:
句意：2011 年諾貝爾和平獎＿＿＿頒給三位女性，表彰她們為爭取女權所做的努力。

三人共同獲獎 → (C) jointly 共同地 ✓

(B) earnestly 誠摯地（全國 38% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：形容做事態度，不能形容「頒獎」的方式。

(A) actively 積極地（全國 22% 誤選）(D) naturally 自然地。
eng110-10.k: 獎頒給「三位女性」一起得 → jointly（共同地）。

eng110-11.stem: The company is ＿＿＿＿ and making great profits under the wise leadership of the chief executive officer.
eng110-11.ex:
句意：在執行長英明的領導下，公司＿＿＿，獲利豐厚。

→ (B) flourishing 興旺、繁榮 ✓

(D) exceeding 超過（全國 23% 誤選）：是及物動詞，要接受詞（exceed expectations）。

(A) applauding 鼓掌（全國 16% 誤選）(C) circulating 流通、循環。
eng110-11.k: 和 making great profits（賺大錢）並列 → 公司 flourishing（蓬勃發展）。

eng110-12.stem: It is absolutely ＿＿＿＿ to waste your money on an expensive car when you cannot even get a driver’s license.
eng110-12.ex:
句意：你連駕照都拿不到，卻把錢浪費在昂貴的車上，真是太＿＿＿了。

→ (A) absurd 荒謬的 ✓

(D) obstinate 固執的（全國 22% 誤選）：形容人，不形容一件事。

(C) vigorous 精力充沛的（全國 20% 誤選）(B) cautious 謹慎的（全國 18% 誤選）。
eng110-12.k: 連駕照都考不到卻花大錢買名車 → 真是 absurd（荒謬的）。

eng110-13.stem: The problem of illegal drug use is very complex and cannot be traced to merely one ＿＿＿＿ reason.
eng110-13.ex:
句意：非法用藥的問題非常複雜，不能只追溯到一個＿＿＿原因。

complex（複雜）對比 merely one（只有一個）→ (A) singular 單一的 ✓

(D) defensive 防禦的（全國 17% 誤選）(B) countable 可數的（全國 16% 誤選）(C) favorable 有利的。
eng110-13.k: 問題很複雜，不能歸因於「單一的」原因 → one singular reason。

eng110-14.stem: The non-profit organization has ＿＿＿＿ $1 million over five years to finance the construction of the medical center.
eng110-14.ex:
句意：這個非營利組織已＿＿＿五年一百萬美元，資助醫療中心的興建。

→ (C) committed 承諾提供、撥出（資金）✓

(B) resolved 下定決心、解決（全國 27% 誤選）：resolve 後面不接金額。

(A) equipped 配備（全國 18% 誤選）(D) associated 聯想、關聯。
eng110-14.k: commit money to…＝承諾撥出款項；非營利組織承諾五年出資一百萬。

eng110-15.stem: One week after the typhoon, some bridges were finally opened and bus service ＿＿＿＿ in the country’s most severely damaged areas.
eng110-15.ex:
句意：颱風過後一週，一些橋梁終於開放，災情最嚴重地區的公車服務也＿＿＿了。

和「橋梁重新開放」並列 → (B) resumed 恢復 ✓

(C) transported 運送（全國 48% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：是及物動詞，要有受詞；「公車服務運送」沒有說運送什麼，句子不完整。

(A) departed 出發（全國 14% 誤選）(D) corresponded 符合、通信。
eng110-15.k: 颱風後橋梁重新開放，公車服務也 resumed（恢復）。

eng110-16.stem: In fact, a visit to a major European city just would not be the same 16 encountering them: bathing in fountains, perching on historic buildings, and flocking in public squares.
eng110-16.ex:
句意：事實上，到歐洲大城市一遊，＿＿＿遇到牠們（在噴泉洗澡、停在古建築上、在廣場成群），就不一樣了。

鴿子是歐洲城市常見的景象 → 少了牠們就不像樣 → (D) without 沒有 ✓

(A) as（全國 52% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：the same as encountering them 意思變成「和遇到牠們一樣」，再加上 would not，句意變成「去歐洲城市和遇到鴿子不一樣」，不合邏輯。

(B) for（全國 16% 誤選）(C) though 雖然。
eng110-16.k: would not be the same without…＝少了…就不一樣了；遊歐洲城市「沒遇到鴿子」就不完整。

eng110-17.stem: In Barcelona, however, the birds are now threatening to 17 the city’s historic center, pooping on monuments, buildings, and even tourists.
eng110-17.ex:
句意：然而在巴塞隆納，鴿子現在快要＿＿＿市區的歷史中心，在紀念碑、建築，甚至遊客身上大便。

→ (C) take over 接管、占據 ✓

(D) break down 損壞、故障（全國 42% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：break down 多半不接受詞，也不是鴿子造成的情況。

(A) set up 設立（全國 13% 誤選）(B) hang on 堅持（全國 13% 誤選）。
eng110-17.k: take over＝占據、接管；鴿子在古蹟、建築、遊客身上大便，快把歷史市中心「占領」了。

eng110-18.stem: The city council originally proposed 18 the pigeon population by gathering the birds and shooting them.
eng110-18.ex:
句意：市議會原本提議用捕捉、射殺的方式＿＿＿鴿子的數量。

propose＋V-ing → (B) reducing 減少 ✓

(D) maintaining 維持（全國 13% 誤選）(C) displaying 展示（全國 10% 誤選）(A) counting 計算。
eng110-18.k: 把鴿子抓起來射殺 → 目的是 reducing（減少）鴿子數量。

eng110-19.stem: After heated debates and discussions, the government was finally persuaded to consider another 19 effective method: giving the pigeons birth control.
eng110-19.ex:
句意：經過激烈辯論，政府終於被說服，考慮另一個＿＿＿有效的方法：讓鴿子節育。

「另一個」和射殺「同樣」能減少鴿子的方法 → (D) similarly 同樣地 ✓

(C) precisely 精確地（全國 35% 誤選）：precisely effective 不是常見搭配，也沒有「和前一個方法比較」的意思。

(B) shortly 不久 (A) nearly 幾乎。
eng110-19.k: another similarly effective method＝另一個同樣有效的方法；可以減少鴿子，又不用射殺。

eng110-20.stem: Starting from April 2017, the pills were placed in 40 bird feeders 20 throughout the city.
eng110-20.ex:
句意：從 2017 年 4 月起，藥丸被放在＿＿＿全市的 40 個鳥類餵食器中。

餵食器是「被安裝」的 → 過去分詞修飾名詞 → (B) installed ✓

(A) installing（全國 20% 誤選）：現在分詞表示主動，餵食器不會自己安裝東西。

(C) to install（全國 16% 誤選）(D) having installed。
eng110-20.k: feeders installed throughout the city＝設置在全市各處的餵食器；被動用過去分詞。

eng110-21.stem: Over the course of an 80-year life span, the odds of being hit by lightning are 1 in 3,000, 21 the probability of being struck seven different times.
eng110-21.ex:
句意：在 80 年的一生中，被雷擊中的機率是三千分之一，＿＿＿被擊中七次的機率。

從「一次都很少」推到「七次更不可能」→ (C) not to mention 更別說 ✓

(B) as you can see 如你所見（全國 24% 誤選）(D) with regard to 關於（全國 19% 誤選）(A) if it isn't 如果不是。
eng110-21.k: not to mention＝更別提；被雷打中一次的機率是三千分之一，更別說被打中七次。

eng110-22.stem: Over his 36-year career, Sullivan was struck by lightning seven times—and 22 each shock!
eng110-22.ex:
句意：在 36 年的職業生涯中，Sullivan 被雷擊中七次——而且每一次都＿＿＿！

下文還有他的訪談，可見他都活下來了 → (C) survived 存活、挺過 ✓

(D) tracked 追蹤（全國 14% 誤選）(B) rejected 拒絕（全國 11% 誤選）(A) piloted 駕駛。
eng110-22.k: 被雷打了七次，而且每次都 survived（活下來了），所以才有驚嘆號。

eng110-23.stem: But after strike four, Sullivan became 23 death and took precautions during lightning strikes.
eng110-23.ex:
句意：但第四次之後，Sullivan 變得＿＿＿死亡，打雷時會採取預防措施。

和 took precautions 呼應 → (A) fearful of 害怕 ✓

(D) positive about 樂觀看待（全國 24% 誤選）(C) doubtful about 懷疑（全國 13% 誤選）(B) critical of 批評。
eng110-23.k: 第四次之後，他開始怕死（fearful of death），打雷時會採取防護措施。

eng110-24.stem: Sullivan, while surveying a campground, felt that a cloud was 24 him, and tried all he could to run—but it got him anyway.
eng110-24.ex:
句意：Sullivan 在勘查營地時，覺得有一朵雲在＿＿＿他，他拚命逃，但還是被打中了。

上一段說雲「chased」他，這裡同樣的事又發生 → (A) coming after 追趕 ✓

(B) getting over 克服（全國 18% 誤選）(C) holding on to 緊抓（全國 13% 誤選）(D) watching out for 提防。
eng110-24.k: 雷雨雲「追著」他 → come after＝追趕；和前一段 A storm cloud "chased" him 相同。

eng110-25.stem: “I don’t believe God is after me,” he theorized. “If he was, the first bolt 25 enough.
eng110-25.ex:
句意：「我不認為上帝在找我麻煩，」他推論，「如果是的話，第一道閃電就＿＿＿夠了。」

條件句 If he was 是假設（上帝其實沒有找他麻煩）；第一道閃電是過去發生的事 → 結果要用 would have p.p. → (D) would have been ✓

(C) would be（全國 41% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：表示現在或未來的假設，但第一次雷擊已經發生在過去。

(B) had been（全國 21% 誤選）：是條件子句的時態，不能用在主要子句。
eng110-25.k: If he was (after me), the first bolt would have been enough：與現在相反的條件＋已發生的第一次雷擊 → 與過去相反的結果。

eng110-26.stem: But some mountain ranges of South America, Africa, and Indonesia are also 26 glaciers and ice sheets.
eng110-26.ex:
句意：冰川通常和寒冷的氣候連在一起，但南美洲、非洲、印尼的一些山脈也＿＿＿冰川和冰原。

→ (A) home to 是…的家、擁有 ✓

(B) covers of（全國 54% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：「山脈是冰川的覆蓋物」主從顛倒；而且 cover 指覆蓋物，不能這樣用來表示「有」。

(C) roofs over 在…上方的屋頂（全國 12% 誤選）(D) room for 容納…的空間。
eng110-26.k: be home to＝是…的所在地、有…；這些山脈「有」冰川和冰原。

eng110-27.stem: A newly published study, however, revealed that rising temperatures are posing an 27 threat to the last tropical glaciers in Indonesia’s Papua region.
eng110-27.ex:
句意：一項新研究顯示，氣溫上升對印尼巴布亞地區最後的熱帶冰川構成＿＿＿威脅。

後文：冰原變薄的速度是幾年前的五倍以上，十年內會完全消失 → (C) immediate 立即的、迫切的 ✓

(D) offensive 冒犯的、攻擊性的（全國 20% 誤選）(A) occasional 偶爾的（全國 12% 誤選）(B) elaborate 精心的（全國 12% 誤選）。
eng110-27.k: 冰原變薄速度是幾年前的五倍、十年內就會消失 → 威脅迫在眉睫（immediate）。

eng110-28.stem: 28 already shrunk by 85% to a mere 0.5 square kilometers, Papua’s glaciers will completely disappear within a decade, researchers have predicted.
eng110-28.ex:
句意：＿＿＿已經縮小了 85%，只剩 0.5 平方公里，研究人員預測巴布亞的冰川將在十年內完全消失。

兩個句子主詞都是冰川，前句的動作（縮小）先發生 → 完成式分詞構句 Having p.p. → (C) Having ✓

(D) Having been（全國 24% 誤選）：Having been shrunk 是被動，「冰川被縮小」不通；shrink 這裡是不及物動詞。

(B) Had（全國 19% 誤選）(A) Have（全國 16% 誤選）：是完整的動詞，放在句首會變成疑問句或倒裝，和逗號後的主要子句接不起來。
eng110-28.k: Having already shrunk…＝（冰川）已經縮小了 85%；完成式分詞構句，主詞同為 Papua's glaciers。

eng110-29.stem: The disappearance of the glaciers will also leave a significant 29 impact.
eng110-29.ex:
句意：冰川消失也會留下重大的＿＿＿影響。對許多巴布亞原住民來說，冰原是神聖的象徵。

下一句談宗教信仰 → (A) cultural 文化的 ✓

(D) environmental 環境的（全國 51% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：前面已經談了環境，這句用 also 帶出「另一種」影響，後文說的是信仰。

(B) moral 道德的 (C) political 政治的。
eng110-29.k: 冰川對原住民是神聖的象徵（神的頭）→ 消失會帶來文化上的衝擊（cultural impact）。

eng110-30.stem: The study warned that Papua’s glaciers are only the “first to go” if greenhouse gases are 30 and temperatures continue rising.
eng110-30.ex:
句意：研究警告，如果溫室氣體＿＿＿，氣溫持續上升，巴布亞的冰川只是「第一個消失」的。

和「氣溫持續上升」同方向 → 溫室氣體不受控制 → (D) left unchecked 放任不管 ✓

(B) made released（全國 52% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：make 的被動要接 to V（be made to release），made released 不合文法。

(C) seen dismissed（全國 17% 誤選）(A) kept balanced 保持平衡（全國 14% 誤選）：保持平衡就不會讓冰川消失。
eng110-30.k: leave…unchecked＝放任不管；如果溫室氣體不受控制、氣溫持續上升，巴布亞冰川只是第一個消失的。

eng110-31.stem: Research shows that 31 amounts of exercise—even just 15 minutes a day—helps ease depression, enhance self-image, relieve stress, and much more.
eng110-31.ex:
詞性分類：名詞 means、soreness、fanatic；形容詞 demanding、current、modest；動詞或片語 point to、argue、abide by、make time。

句意：研究顯示，＿＿＿運動量——就算一天只有 15 分鐘——也有助於緩解憂鬱、提升自我形象、紓解壓力等等。

amounts 前面要形容詞，又由「只要 15 分鐘」說明 → (J) modest 適度的、不多的 ✓

(C) point to（全國 16% 誤選）：是動詞片語，不能修飾名詞。

(E) demanding 費力的（全國 10% 誤選）：和「只要 15 分鐘」相反。
eng110-31.k: modest amounts of exercise＝適量（不多）的運動；破折號後補充「一天只要 15 分鐘」。

eng110-32.stem: Doing exercise makes you happy, and you don’t have to be a fitness 32 to do it.
eng110-32.ex:
句意：運動讓你快樂，而且你不必是個健身＿＿＿也能做到。

a fitness＋名詞 → (G) fanatic 狂熱者 ✓

(E) demanding（全國 18% 誤選）：形容詞，不能放在冠詞 a 和 fitness 之後當中心名詞。

(A) means 方法（全國 12% 誤選）。
eng110-32.k: a fitness fanatic＝健身狂；不必是健身狂也能做運動。

eng110-33.stem: What you need to do is to make “start slow and have fun” a motto to 33 .
eng110-33.ex:
句意：你要做的，是把「慢慢開始、玩得開心」當成一句要＿＿＿的座右銘。

不定詞修飾 motto，後面要動詞，「遵守」座右銘 → (F) abide by 遵守 ✓

(G) fanatic（全國 10% 誤選）(C) point to（全國 10% 誤選）。
eng110-33.k: a motto to abide by＝一句要遵守的座右銘。

eng110-34.stem: In fact, 34 health studies prove that exercise doesn’t have to hurt to be effective.
eng110-34.ex:
句意：「沒有痛苦就沒有收穫」的運動觀念現在被認為過時了。事實上，＿＿＿健康研究證明，運動不必很痛才有效。

和 old-fashioned（過時的）相對 → (H) current 當前的 ✓

(F) abide by（全國 11% 誤選）(C) point to（全國 11% 誤選）：都是動詞片語，不能放在名詞前。
eng110-34.k: current health studies＝當前的健康研究；和前一句「舊觀念」對比。

eng110-35.stem: You might 35 that if working out doesn’t give you pain, it isn’t working.
eng110-35.ex:
句意：你也許會＿＿＿，如果運動不會痛，就沒有效果。

might 後面接原形動詞，後面接 that 子句 → (D) argue 主張 ✓

(C) point to（全國 8% 誤選）：point to 後面接名詞，不接 that 子句。

(E) demanding（全國 5% 誤選）。
eng110-35.k: You might argue that…＝你也許會主張…（提出一個要被反駁的看法）。

eng110-36.stem: According to fitness trainers, physically 36 exercises may make you breathe heavily and your muscles may ache temporarily, but exercise should not be painful.
eng110-36.ex:
句意：根據健身教練的說法，身體＿＿＿運動可能讓你喘不過氣、肌肉暫時痠痛，但運動不該是痛苦的。

副詞 physically 修飾形容詞，又會讓人喘 → (E) demanding 費力的、要求高的 ✓

(G) fanatic（全國 14% 誤選）(C) point to（全國 12% 誤選）。
eng110-36.k: physically demanding exercises＝體力負荷大的運動，會讓你喘、肌肉暫時痠痛。

eng110-37.stem: In fact, if it is, it may 37 an injury or muscle strain.
eng110-37.ex:
句意：事實上，如果運動會痛，可能＿＿＿受傷或肌肉拉傷。

may 後面接原形動詞，接名詞 an injury → (C) point to 指向、顯示 ✓

(F) abide by（全國 20% 誤選）：「遵守受傷」意思不通。

(A) means（全國 12% 誤選）。
eng110-37.k: if it is (painful), it may point to an injury＝如果會痛，可能表示受傷了。

eng110-38.stem: Many great forms of exercise—like walking, swimming, or gentle stretching—get results without the 38 or discomfort some people associate with exercise.
eng110-38.ex:
句意：很多很好的運動，像走路、游泳、輕度伸展，不會有某些人聯想到的＿＿＿或不適，也能看到成效。

the＋名詞＋or discomfort → (B) soreness 痠痛 ✓

(G) fanatic（全國 8% 誤選）(J) modest（全國 7% 誤選）。
eng110-38.k: without the soreness or discomfort＝不會有痠痛或不適；和 discomfort 並列要名詞。

eng110-39.stem: Keep in mind that even short periods of low-impact exercise serve as a powerful 39 to improve your health.
eng110-39.ex:
句意：記住，就算只做短時間的低衝擊運動，也是改善健康的有力＿＿＿。

(G) fanatic（全國 15% 誤選）(E) demanding（全國 11% 誤選）。
eng110-39.k: a powerful means to improve your health＝改善健康的有力方法；means 單複數同形。

eng110-40.stem: So, no matter how busy you are, try to 40 for exercise every day, like a 15-minute walk with your dog.
eng110-40.ex:
句意：所以，不論你多忙，每天都要試著＿＿＿運動，例如帶狗散步 15 分鐘。

try to＋原形動詞，搭配 for → (I) make time 騰出時間 ✓

(J) modest（全國 4% 誤選）(E) demanding（全國 4% 誤選）。
eng110-40.k: make time for exercise＝撥出時間運動，像每天遛狗 15 分鐘。

eng111-15.stem: As digital reading is changing our traditional way of reading, book towns like Hay-on-Wye are particularly important to 15 .

eng111-16.stem: The round windows are indeed pleasant to the eye, but they actually were designed for reasons 16 aesthetics.

eng111-18.stem: The problem is 18 when airplanes fly at higher altitudes, where the difference between the inside and outside pressure increases, causing added stress.

eng111-21.stem: In this line of work, the person is paid to do daring actions that are deemed too 21 for the regular actor to perform, including jumping from heights, crashing cars, or fighting with weapons.

eng111-37.k: 19 世紀和歐洲人交易後，天然材料被彩色玻璃珠取代 → 彩色玻璃串珠從那時流行起來。

eng111-38.stem: Why does the author quote Blixen’s comment at the end of the third paragraph?
o: To explain how Maasai warriors hunt for deer in the wild.
To exemplify the types of weapons used by Maasai warriors.
To emphasize that weapons are an inseparable part of a Maasai warrior’s outfit.
To show the similarities between the behavior of a Maasai warrior and that of a male deer.

eng111-39.stem: Which of the following aspects about hard hats is NOT discussed in the passage?
eng111-39.ex:
這題選「沒有討論」的。

(D) 限制：文中沒有提到安全帽的缺點或不足 ✓

In what order did the following protective hats appear?

eng111-41.stem: According to the passage, which of the following statements is true about the hard hat?

The inspiration came from the inventor’s wartime experience.
It was standard equipment for construction workers in the 1920s.
Different colors are used in different industries to signal the roles of people on site.

(D) 顏色代表的是同一工地上不同的角色（工人、主管、檢查員），不是不同產業（全國 33% 誤選）✗

(A) 2016 年 21 億、2025 年預估 31.9 億，不是每十年翻倍 ✗

eng111-43.stem: What can we learn about zebrafish from the passage?
o: How they should be studied in labs.
What they may offer in medical advancements.
eng111-43.ex:
(D) 斑馬魚的再生能力可能帶來新的失明療法，「some of the nearly 40 million blind people … may one day have a tiny, striped fish to thank」✓

eng111-44.stem: Which of the following statements is true regarding GABA in zebrafish?
o: There is a high level of GABA in the brain of zebrafish.
Lowering GABA levels in the brain can stimulate retina regrowth.
GABA contains chemical elements that trigger the growth of neurons.

eng111-44.k: 降低 GABA 濃度能啟動視網膜再生，GABA 濃度高反而會抑制。

eng111-45.stem: Which of the following is closest in meaning to “replicated” in the third paragraph?
eng111-45.ex:
句子：如果斑馬魚視網膜再生的過程能在人類身上 replicated，就可能帶來新的失明療法。

(B) Reassembled 重新組裝（全國 25% 誤選）(D) Restored 恢復（全國 16% 誤選）(C) Recycled 回收。

eng111-46.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is an opinion, but NOT a fact?
o: Humans and zebrafish have 70 percent of genes in common.
Zebrafish can quickly recover vision after damage to the retina.
Scientists are testing if the GABA theory works on mice as it does on zebrafish.
Understanding regeneration in zebrafish may allow humans to regrow their organs.
eng111-46.ex:
這題選「是意見而不是事實」的。

(B) 視網膜受損後三、四週視力就恢復 → 研究觀察到的事實（全國 19% 誤選）

(C) 研究團隊正在老鼠身上測試 GABA 理論 → 事實（全國 22% 誤選）
eng111-46.k: 「may allow humans to regrow their organs」是科學家的期望（推測），不是已證實的事實。

(A) sticky 黏的 ✓

(B) greasy 油膩的 (C) clumsy 笨拙的 (D) mighty 強大的。

eng112-02.stem: Jesse is a talented model. He can easily adopt an elegant ＿＿＿＿ for a camera shoot.

(C) pose 姿勢 ✓

(A) clap 拍手 (B) toss 拋擲 (D) snap 啪的一聲、快照。

eng112-03.stem: In order to draw her family tree, Mary tried to trace her ＿＿＿＿ back to their arrival in North America.
eng112-03.ex:
句意：為了畫家譜，Mary 試著把她的＿＿＿追溯到他們抵達北美洲的時候。

family tree（家譜）→ (C) ancestors 祖先 ✓

(A) siblings 兄弟姊妹 (B) commuters 通勤者 (D) instructors 講師。

eng112-04.stem: Upon the super typhoon warning, Nancy rushed to the supermarket—only to find the shelves almost ＿＿＿＿ and the stock nearly gone.
eng112-04.ex:

bare 空的、光禿禿的 → (B) ✓

(A) blank 空白的（紙、表格）、(C) hollow 中空的（樹幹、牆），都不是「東西被買光」的意思（各約 30% 誤選）。

(D) queer 奇怪的。
eng112-04.k: bare shelves＝貨架空空的（被搶購一空）。

eng112-05.stem: Even though Jack said “Sorry!” to me in person, I did not feel any ＿＿＿＿ in his apology.
eng112-05.ex:
句意：雖然 Jack 當面對我說了「對不起」，我在他的道歉中感受不到任何＿＿＿。

(D) sincerity 真誠 ✓

(B) generosity 慷慨（24% 誤選）(A) liability 責任、負債 (C) integrity 正直。

eng112-06.stem: My grandfather has astonishing powers of ＿＿＿＿ . He can still vividly describe his first day at school as a child.
eng112-06.ex:
句意：我祖父有驚人的＿＿＿，到現在還能生動地描述他小時候第一天上學的情形。

後句「還能生動描述小時候的事」→ 記性好 → (D) recall 記憶力 ✓（powers of recall 是常見說法）

(A) resolve 決心 (B) fraction 小部分、分數 (C) privilege 特權。
eng112-06.k: powers of recall＝記憶力（recall 當名詞是「回想、記憶」）。

eng112-07.stem: Recent research has found lots of evidence to ＿＿＿＿ the drug company’s claims about its “miracle” tablets for curing cancer.
eng112-07.ex:
句意：最近的研究找到許多證據來＿＿＿這家藥廠對它治癌「神藥」的說法。

證據是用來「反駁」藥廠的說法 → (B) counter 反駁、反擊 ✓

(C) expose 揭露（全國 33% 誤選；常用來揭露祕密、醜聞，或 expose A as B「揭穿 A 是 B」）(A) provoke 激起、挑釁 (D) convert 轉換、改變信仰。

這題四個選項的選答率幾乎一樣，counter 當動詞的用法很多人不熟。
eng112-07.k: evidence to counter the claims＝反駁說法的證據。

eng112-08.stem: Corrupt officials and misguided policies have ＿＿＿＿ the country’s economy and burdened its people with enormous foreign debts.
eng112-08.ex:
句意：貪官和錯誤的政策＿＿＿國家的經濟，還讓人民背負龐大的外債。

「貪官、錯誤政策」造成的是負面結果 → (A) crippled 使癱瘓、重創 ✓

(B) accelerated 加速（全國 31% 誤選；accelerate the economy 是「促進經濟成長」，是正面意思）(C) rendered 使成為（後面要接受詞＋補語）(D) ventured 冒險。
eng112-08.k: cripple the economy＝重創經濟（cripple＝使癱瘓）。

eng112-09.stem: As a record number of fans showed up for the baseball final, the highways around the stadium were ＿＿＿＿ with traffic all day.
eng112-09.ex:
句意：棒球總冠軍賽湧進破紀錄的球迷，球場周邊的公路一整天都被車流＿＿＿。

車子多到動彈不得 → (A) choked 堵塞 ✓

(B) disturbed 打擾（全國 31% 誤選）(C) enclosed 圍住（全國 19% 誤選）(D) injected 注射。
eng112-09.k: be choked with traffic＝被車流塞住、交通堵塞。

eng112-10.stem: Studies show that the ＿＿＿＿ unbiased media are in fact often deeply influenced by political ideology.
eng112-10.ex:
句意：研究顯示，＿＿＿公正的媒體，事實上常深受政治意識型態影響。

in fact 表示和前面的說法相反 → 表面上公正、實際不然 → (D) supposedly 據說、表面上 ✓

(B) roughly 大約（全國 25% 誤選）(A) undoubtedly 無疑地（全國 22% 誤選）(C) understandably 可以理解地。
eng112-10.k: supposedly＝據說、表面上；後面 in fact（事實上）表示真相相反。

eng112-11.stem: It looks like a precisely engineered jigsaw puzzle, each branch growing just perfectly so it almost, 11 , touches the neighboring tree.
eng112-11.ex:
句意：看起來像精密設計的拼圖，每根樹枝都長得恰到好處，幾乎、＿＿＿碰到隔壁的樹。

上一句說抬頭會看到樹枝之間的「縫隙」形成網狀裂紋 → 幾乎碰到、但沒有碰到 → (C) but not quite ✓

(D) and pretty much 而且差不多（全國 29% 誤選）：等於說碰到了，和「縫隙」矛盾。

(B) by all means 務必、當然可以（全國 28% 誤選）(A) in no time 立刻。
eng112-11.k: almost, but not quite, touches＝幾乎、卻又沒有真的碰到；所以樹冠之間才有一道道縫隙（crown shyness）。

eng112-12.stem: Scientists have been discussing crown shyness since the 1920s, proposing 12 explanations for the phenomenon.
eng112-12.ex:
句意：科學家從 1920 年代就在討論樹冠羞避，對這個現象提出＿＿＿解釋。

下文先說「有些研究者」認為是避免樹枝撞斷，再說「其他科學家」認為是爭奪資源 → (D) multiple 多種的 ✓

(A) universal 普遍的（全國 15% 誤選）(C) conventional 傳統的（全國 15% 誤選）(B) productive 有成效的。
eng112-12.k: 後文列出 Some researchers… Other scientists… 兩種說法 → 提出「多種」解釋（multiple）。

eng112-13.stem: Other scientists suggest that plants, like animals, 13 resources—nutrients, water, space, and light.
eng112-13.ex:
句意：其他科學家認為，植物和動物一樣會＿＿＿資源：養分、水、空間和陽光。

下一句說樹冠濃密的森林裡，對這些資源有激烈的爭奪 → (B) compete for 爭奪 ✓

(D) make up for 彌補（全國 22% 誤選）(C) give way to 讓步給、被…取代（全國 13% 誤選）(A) get over 克服。
eng112-13.k: 下一句 intense struggle for these resources（激烈爭奪這些資源）→ 植物也會 compete for resources。

eng112-14.stem: Gaps in the treetops resulting from crown shyness may allow trees to increase their 14 light and enhance photosynthesis.
eng112-14.ex:
句意：樹冠羞避造成的縫隙，可能讓樹木增加＿＿＿光，增強光合作用。

要加強光合作用，就要讓葉子照到更多光 → (B) exposure to 暴露於、受到照射 ✓

(D) reflection on 反射、反省（全國 17% 誤選）(C) sensitivity to 對…的敏感度（全國 16% 誤選）(A) reliance on 依賴。
eng112-14.k: 樹冠有縫隙，樹木能接受更多陽光照射（exposure to light），光合作用就更好。

eng112-15.stem: 15 decades of investigation, there is no consensus on exactly what causes the beautiful and mysterious phenomenon of crown shyness.
eng112-15.ex:
句意：＿＿＿數十年的研究，對於樹冠羞避的成因仍然沒有共識。

「研究了很久」和「還是沒有定論」語意相反 → (C) Despite 儘管 ✓（Despite 是介系詞，後面接名詞 decades of investigation）

(A) For（全國 27% 誤選）：for 表示「為了、持續」，無法表達這裡的轉折。

(B) Besides 除了…之外還 (D) Concerning 關於。
eng112-15.k: 研究了幾十年，卻仍沒有共識 → 前後是讓步關係，用 Despite（儘管）。

eng112-16.stem: In the earlier days of space travel, scientists tried to overcome the force of gravity so that a rocket could shoot 16 Earth’s pull in order to land humans on the moon.
eng112-16.ex:
句意：太空旅行早期，科學家設法克服重力，讓火箭能＿＿＿地球的引力，把人送上月球。

克服重力 → 擺脫引力 → (B) free of 擺脫、不受…束縛 ✓

(D) straight on 一直向前（全國 33% 誤選）：shoot straight on Earth's pull 意思不通。

(A) back to 回到（全國 17% 誤選）(C) long before 早在…之前。
eng112-16.k: shoot free of Earth's pull＝衝出、擺脫地球引力；前面說科學家想克服重力。

eng112-17.stem: Today, they are more interested in how reduced gravity affects the astronauts’ 17 condition.
eng112-17.ex:
句意：現在科學家更關心重力減少如何影響太空人的＿＿＿狀況。

下一段說體液往上半身移動、臉變浮腫，還有頭痛、噁心 → (A) physical 身體的 ✓

(C) mental 心理的（全國 13% 誤選）(B) perceptual 知覺的 (D) external 外在的。
eng112-17.k: 後文談體液上移、臉部浮腫、頭痛 → 重力影響的是身體狀況（physical condition）。

eng112-18.stem: However, with the absence of gravity in the outer space, our body fluids 18 , shifting toward the upper body and the head.
eng112-18.ex:
句意：然而，外太空沒有重力，我們的體液會＿＿＿，往上半身和頭部移動。

這句缺少主要動詞；全段用現在式說明一般現象（we have more fluids…, they are pulled down…）→ (A) redistribute 重新分布 ✓

(B) redistributed（全國 35% 誤選）：過去式和全段說明事實的現在式不一致。

(C) redistributing（全國 25% 誤選）(D) being redistributed：都不是主要動詞，句子會沒有動詞。
eng112-18.k: 主詞 our body fluids 需要一個現在式的主要動詞 redistribute；後面的 shifting… 是分詞構句。

eng112-19.stem: This “Charlie Brown effect” will be more 19 when the astronauts go on their Mars missions, which will take about three years to complete, much longer than missions to the moon.
eng112-19.ex:
句意：太空人執行火星任務時，「查理布朗效應」會更＿＿＿，因為任務約需三年，比登月任務長得多。

待在低重力的時間越長，症狀越明顯 → (C) severe 嚴重的 ✓

(D) aggressive 有攻擊性的（全國 17% 誤選）(B) unusual 不尋常的（全國 15% 誤選）(A) contagious 傳染性的（全國 14% 誤選）。
eng112-19.k: 火星任務約三年，比登月任務長得多 → 查理布朗效應會更嚴重（severe）。

eng112-20.stem: Moreover, the effect is often 20 space motion sickness, headaches, and nausea.
eng112-20.ex:
句意：此外，這個效應常＿＿＿太空暈動症、頭痛和噁心。

臉部浮腫和這些症狀一起出現 → (D) accompanied by 伴隨著 ✓

(B) brought about（全國 40% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：bring about 是「引起」，被動要說 is brought about by…；少了 by，句子不通。

(A) varied with 隨…而變化 (C) transferred from 從…轉移。
eng112-20.k: be accompanied by＝伴隨著；這個效應常伴隨暈動症、頭痛和噁心。

eng112-21.stem: Yet, is water always the healthiest drink we can 21 ?
eng112-21.ex:
詞性分類：名詞 absorption、option、status；形容詞 active、effective；動詞或片語 combat、pass through、reach for；alert、even 可當動詞也可當形容詞。

句意：然而，水永遠是我們能＿＿＿的最健康飲料嗎？

助動詞 can 後面要原形動詞，意思是「拿來喝」→ (J) reach for 伸手去拿 ✓

(E) option 選擇（全國 15% 誤選）：是名詞，不能接在 can 後面。

(D) combat 對抗（全國 11% 誤選）：意思不通。
eng112-21.k: can 後面要原形動詞；reach for a drink＝伸手拿飲料，問「水是不是我們能拿來喝的最健康飲料」。

eng112-22.stem: Obviously, a physically 22 person with an outdoor job under the sun will need to drink more fluid than a desk-bound person who lives and works in an air-conditioned place.
eng112-22.ex:
句意：顯然，在太陽下做戶外工作、身體＿＿＿的人，要比整天坐在冷氣房辦公的人喝更多水。

副詞 physically 修飾形容詞，和 desk-bound（久坐的）相對 → (B) active 活躍的 ✓

(H) status 狀態（全國 8% 誤選）(C) alert 警覺的（全國 7% 誤選）。
eng112-22.k: physically active＝身體活動量大的；和後面「整天坐辦公桌、待在冷氣房的人」對比。

eng112-23.stem: To 23 things out, the body will get rid of water by producing urine.
eng112-23.ex:
句意：只補充白開水，身體會水太多、鹽不夠。為了＿＿＿，身體會產生尿液排掉水分。

to 後面要原形動詞，搭配 out：even out 使平均、使平衡 → (G) even ✓

(D) combat（全國 28% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：combat 是「對抗」，沒有 combat things out 的用法。

(I) pass through（全國 15% 誤選）：後面已有 things out，接不上。
eng112-23.k: even things out＝使平衡；身體水太多、鹽不夠，就靠排尿把水排掉來取得平衡。

eng112-24.stem: For this reason, milk can actually be more 24 than drinking water.
eng112-24.ex:
句意：因此，牛奶其實可能比喝水更＿＿＿。

be 動詞後、more 後面要形容詞；下一句說牛奶含鹽與乳糖、能幫助吸收水分 → (F) effective 有效的 ✓

(G) even（全國 6% 誤選）(A) absorption（全國 6% 誤選）。
eng112-24.k: 牛奶含鹽和乳糖，補水「更有效」（more effective）。

eng112-25.stem: Milk naturally contains salt and lactose, a sugar which the human body needs in small amounts to help stimulate water 25 .
eng112-25.ex:
句意：牛奶天然含有鹽和乳糖，人體需要少量乳糖來幫助刺激水分＿＿＿。

動詞 stimulate 的受詞要名詞，和 water 組成「水分吸收」→ (A) absorption 吸收 ✓

(H) status（全國 10% 誤選）(G) even（全國 10% 誤選）。
eng112-25.k: stimulate water absorption＝促進水分吸收；water absorption 是名詞＋名詞的複合名詞。

eng112-26.stem: Coconut water, which contains salt and carbohydrates, is also more functional than water at restoring and maintaining a normal fluid 26 after exercise.
eng112-26.ex:
句意：椰子水含有鹽和碳水化合物，運動後在恢復、維持正常的體液＿＿＿上，也比水更有效。

a normal fluid ＿＿ 要名詞 → (H) status 狀態 ✓

(G) even（全國 31% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：even 不能當名詞，不能放在冠詞 a 和形容詞 normal 之後當中心語。

(A) absorption（全國 12% 誤選）：前面已經用過，而且「恢復吸收」意思不對。
eng112-26.k: a normal fluid status＝正常的體液狀態；a＋形容詞＋名詞，空格要名詞。

eng112-27.stem: For the average person, however, water remains a very good 27 for keeping hydrated—if you know how to drink it.
eng112-27.ex:
句意：然而，對一般人來說，水仍然是保持身體水分的很好＿＿＿——只要你知道怎麼喝。

a very good 後面要名詞 → (E) option 選擇 ✓

(H) status（全國 15% 誤選）(A) absorption（全國 9% 誤選）。
eng112-27.k: a very good option for keeping hydrated＝保持水分的好選擇。

eng112-28.stem: The secret is: Never wait until the body is telling you you’re thirsty, since there must already have been significant changes in your body for it to eventually 28 your consciousness.
eng112-28.ex:
句意：不要等身體告訴你口渴，因為身體一定已經有了明顯的變化，才終於＿＿＿你的意識。

for＋受詞＋to＋原形動詞，「口渴」就是身體在提醒你 → (C) alert 向…發出警報、提醒 ✓

(J) reach for（全國 10% 誤選）(D) combat（全國 8% 誤選）。
eng112-28.k: for it (the body) to alert your consciousness＝身體向你的意識發出警訊（覺得口渴）。

eng112-29.stem: Also, drinking a lot of liquid in one go can cause more water to 29 the body quickly and come out as urine.
eng112-29.ex:
句意：一次喝大量的水，會讓更多的水很快＿＿＿身體，變成尿排出來。

cause＋受詞＋to＋原形動詞，和 come out as urine 並列 → (I) pass through 通過 ✓

(C) alert（全國 9% 誤選）(D) combat（全國 8% 誤選）。
eng112-29.k: cause more water to pass through the body quickly＝讓水很快通過身體，變成尿排出。

eng112-30.stem: To 30 this, you need to drink water throughout the day to maintain your hydration levels.
eng112-30.ex:
句意：為了＿＿＿這個情形，你要整天持續喝水，維持身體的含水量。

this 指「一次喝太多水，很快就排掉」的問題，要「對抗、解決」它 → (D) combat 對抗 ✓

(J) reach for（全國 26% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：reach for this 是「伸手拿這個」，意思不通。

(I) pass through（全國 10% 誤選）。
eng112-30.k: To combat this＝為了對抗這個問題（一次喝太多會很快排掉）；所以要整天分次喝水。

eng112-31.stem:
In others, words can trigger a real sensation of taste on their tongue. 31 In the early 1990s, however, scientists noticed that synesthetic colors do not change over time. When asked what color is evoked by a letter or number, synesthetic people would persistently give the same answer even if tested months or years apart.
空格 31 應填入哪一句？
o: This consistency serves as a proof that synesthesia is real.
Meanwhile, environmental influences seem to shape a person’s synesthesia.
People with synesthesia used to be accused of making their experiences up.
Some studies even show that people may all be synesthetic to some degree.
eng112-31.ex:
空格後：However（然而）1990 年代初，科學家注意到聯覺者看到的顏色不會隨時間改變。

however 前面要有相反的說法：以前大家不相信 → (C) People with synesthesia used to be accused of making their experiences up.（聯覺者過去常被指控捏造經驗）✓

(A)（全國 21% 誤選）This consistency 要接在「答案一直相同」之後，是第 32 題。

(D)（全國 21% 誤選）談「人人都可能有某種程度的聯覺」，屬於最後一段。
eng112-31.k: 空格後 In the early 1990s, however, … → however 表示轉折：以前被懷疑是編造的，後來科學家才發現證據。

eng112-32.stem:
When asked what color is evoked by a letter or number, synesthetic people would persistently give the same answer even if tested months or years apart. 32 The most compelling support, however, comes from brain scans, which show that color processing areas in the brain light up when these people listen to certain words.
空格 32 應填入哪一句？
o: This consistency serves as a proof that synesthesia is real.
Meanwhile, environmental influences seem to shape a person’s synesthesia.
People with synesthesia used to be accused of making their experiences up.
Some studies even show that people may all be synesthetic to some degree.
eng112-32.ex:
前句：問聯覺者某個字母或數字是什麼顏色，即使相隔數月或數年，答案始終相同。

後句：However，最有力的支持來自腦部掃描。

(A) This consistency serves as a proof that synesthesia is real.（這種一致性證明聯覺確實存在）✓ ——This consistency 指前句的「答案始終相同」；後句說「最有力的」支持，表示前面已有一項證據。

(D) 人人都可能有某種程度的聯覺（全國 17% 誤選）(B) 環境的影響（全國 15% 誤選）(C) 以前被懷疑造假（全國 14% 誤選）。
eng112-32.k: 前一句說聯覺者隔了幾年答案仍相同（consistency）→ 這種一致性證明聯覺是真的；下一句 The most compelling support 再補更有力的證據。

eng112-33.stem:
But an actual synesthesia gene (or genes) has not been identified yet. 33 For example, the flavors people with taste-word synesthesia experience are usually childhood flavors, such as chocolate or strawberries. Also, people with color-music synesthesia more often than not have had early musical training.
空格 33 應填入哪一句？
o: This consistency serves as a proof that synesthesia is real.
Meanwhile, environmental influences seem to shape a person’s synesthesia.
People with synesthesia used to be accused of making their experiences up.
Some studies even show that people may all be synesthetic to some degree.
eng112-33.ex:
前句：科學家同意聯覺有遺傳基礎，但還沒找到真正的聯覺基因。

後句 For example：味覺聯覺者嘗到的多是巧克力、草莓等童年的味道；色樂聯覺者通常很早學音樂。

例子都是成長經驗 → (B) Meanwhile, environmental influences seem to shape a person's synesthesia.（同時，環境似乎也會塑造聯覺）✓

(C)（全國 31% 誤選）「以前被指控造假」和遺傳、環境無關，例子也接不上。
eng112-33.k: 空格後舉例：味道多半是童年的味道、色樂聯覺者多學過音樂 → 都是「環境」影響聯覺的例子。

eng112-34.stem:
Once thought to be extremely rare, synesthesia is now found to affect about one to four percent of the population. 34 As is often observed, most of us tend to associate lower notes with darker colors and higher notes with brighter colors. Researchers further point out that in most people synesthesia is active only during the first months of their infancy, while this ability remains forever in certain individuals.
空格 34 應填入哪一句？
o: This consistency serves as a proof that synesthesia is real.
Meanwhile, environmental influences seem to shape a person’s synesthesia.
People with synesthesia used to be accused of making their experiences up.
Some studies even show that people may all be synesthetic to some degree.
eng112-34.ex:
前句：聯覺曾被認為極罕見，現在發現約 1%–4% 的人有。

後句：我們大多數人都傾向把低音聯想成暗色、高音聯想成亮色；而且多數人在嬰兒期的頭幾個月都有聯覺。

→ (D) Some studies even show that people may all be synesthetic to some degree.（有些研究甚至顯示人人都可能有某種程度的聯覺）✓

(B)（全國 26% 誤選）講環境影響，是第 33 題。
eng112-34.k: 後句 most of us tend to associate lower notes with darker colors → 大多數人都有一點聯覺。

eng112-45.stem: Which of the following can be inferred from the passage about Zanzibar?
o: For centuries, Zanzibar has been a heaven for beach lovers.

Vasco da Gama was Zanzibar’s first foreign ruler during the Age of Exploration.

(A) settlements、posts 是波斯人建立的聚落與貿易站；crossroads 是說它「位在」香料之路的交會點（全國 20% 誤選）✗

eng113-01.stem: People who desire a ＿＿＿＿ figure should exercise regularly and maintain healthy eating habits.

eng113-02.stem: Watching the sun ＿＿＿＿ from a sea of clouds is a must-do activity for all visitors to Ali Mountain.

(A) emerging 浮現、出現 ✓

(D) floating 漂浮（全國 18% 誤選）(B) flashing 閃爍 (C) rushing 衝。

eng113-04.stem: The roasting heat and high ＿＿＿＿ made me feel hot and sticky, no matter what I did to cool off.

(B) humidity 濕度 ✓

(D) atmosphere 大氣、氣氛（全國 21% 誤選）(A) density 密度 (C) circulation 循環。

eng113-05.stem: Artwork created by truly great artists such as Picasso and Monet will no doubt ＿＿＿＿ the test of time.

(D) stand ✓——stand the test of time 是固定片語。

eng113-06.stem: In some countries, military service is ＿＿＿＿ for men only; women do not have to serve in the military.
eng113-06.ex:
句意：在某些國家，只有男性必須＿＿＿服兵役；女性不用。

「必須服役」→ (C) compulsory 義務的、強制的 ✓

(D) distinctive 獨特的（29% 誤選）(A) forceful 強而有力的（26% 誤選）(B) realistic 實際的。
eng113-06.k: compulsory＝強制的、義務的；後句 women do not have to serve 是對照。

eng113-07.stem: The team complained that its leader always took the ＿＿＿＿ for all the hard work done by the team members.
eng113-07.ex:
句意：團隊抱怨領導者總是把成員辛苦完成的工作＿＿＿。

take the credit for sth＝居功 → (D) credit ✓

(A) take advantage of 是「利用」，後面要接 of，不接 for（全國 39% 誤選）。

(B) revenge 報復 (C) remedy 補救。
eng113-07.k: take the credit for＝把功勞攬在自己身上。

eng113-08.stem: Located at the center of the city, the business hotel ＿＿＿＿ not only good service but also convenient public transport.
eng113-08.ex:
句意：這家商務旅館位於市中心，＿＿＿不只有好服務，還有便利的大眾運輸。

(C) promises 保證提供 ✓——描述旅館「能帶給客人什麼」。

(B) contains 包含，指容器或物體內含某物，不能說旅館 contains 交通便利（全國 58% 誤選，是本週最容易錯的陷阱）。

(A) proposes 提議 (D) confirms 確認。
eng113-08.k: promise＝保證會有（某種好處）；contain 是「實體裡面裝著」。

eng113-09.stem: As blood supplies have fallen to a critically low level, many hospitals are making an ＿＿＿＿ for the public to donate blood.
eng113-09.ex:
句意：血庫存量降到危險的低點，許多醫院正＿＿＿民眾捐血。

make an appeal for sb to do sth → (A) appeal 呼籲 ✓

(C) operation 手術（26% 誤選）(B) approach 方法 (D) observation 觀察。
eng113-09.k: make an appeal for the public to…＝呼籲大眾去做…。

eng113-10.stem: David felt disappointed when he found out that he could not choose his study partners, but would be ＿＿＿＿ placed in a study group.
eng113-10.ex:
句意：David 發現不能自己選讀書夥伴，而是會被＿＿＿分組，覺得很失望。

不能自己選 → (B) randomly 隨機地 ✓

(A) eligibly 合格地 (C) apparently 顯然 (D) consequently 因此。

eng113-11.stem: Sometimes referred to as secret shoppers, mystery shoppers 11 regular customers to purchase items, eat in restaurants, make inquiries, or return items.
eng113-11.ex:
句意：神祕客有時也叫秘密購物者，他們＿＿＿一般顧客，去買東西、到餐廳用餐、詢問或退貨。

假裝成一般顧客去觀察 → (B) pose as 假扮成 ✓

(C) attend to 照顧、處理（全國 25% 誤選）(A) call for 需要、要求 (D) engage in 從事（後面接活動，不接人）。
eng113-11.k: pose as＋身分＝假扮成…；神祕客是假裝成一般顧客去消費。

eng113-12.stem: They grade and report on the quality of products, customer service, and environment of the stores 12 they are assigned.
eng113-12.ex:
句意：他們評估並回報被指派前往的商店的產品品質、顧客服務與環境。

原本是 they are assigned to the stores，改成關係子句時把 to 移到 which 前面 → (D) to which ✓

(B) with which（全國 25% 誤選）：be assigned with 不是這裡的意思。

(A) in that 表示「因為」；(C) for that：關係代名詞 that 前面不能放介系詞。
eng113-12.k: they are assigned to the stores → the stores to which they are assigned（介系詞 to 移到 which 前面）。

eng113-13.stem: When evaluating a business, mystery shoppers have to follow certain standard procedures to avoid 13 .
eng113-13.ex:
句意：評估商家時，神祕客必須遵守某些標準程序，以避免＿＿＿。

下一句：他們常拿到一份檢核表，確保觀察的一致性（consistency）→ 要避免的是 (D) personal bias 個人偏見 ✓

(B) financial hardship 經濟困難（全國 20% 誤選）(A) keen competitions 激烈的競爭 (C) racial conflicts 種族衝突。
eng113-13.k: 照標準程序是為了避免 personal bias（個人偏見）；下一句說檢核表是為了確保一致性。

eng113-14.stem: They may also pretend to be 14 customers, arguing with a salesperson without a good reason.
eng113-14.ex:
句意：他們也可能假裝成＿＿＿顧客，沒有好理由就和店員爭執。

無理取鬧的顧客＝難搞的顧客 → (A) difficult 難應付的 ✓

(D) anonymous 匿名的（全國 45% 誤選，比答對的人還多）：神祕客本來就是匿名的，但「匿名」解釋不了「無故和店員爭執」。

(B) potential 潛在的 (C) constant 經常的。
eng113-14.k: 後面說「沒有好理由就和店員爭執」→ 假裝成難搞的顧客（difficult customers）。

eng113-15.stem: With the data they collect, mystery shoppers can identify areas for 15 and thereby help enhance the quality of products and services.

要提升品質，先找出要「改進」的地方 → (C) improvement 改進 ✓

(D) management 管理（全國 19% 誤選）(A) distribution 分配 (B) expectation 期待。
eng113-15.k: identify areas for improvement＝找出需要改進的地方；後面說能幫忙提升產品與服務品質。

eng113-16.stem: They 16 alarm clocks because adjustable alarms had been invented by the mid-19th century.
eng113-16.ex:
句意：他們＿＿＿鬧鐘，因為可調式鬧鐘在 19 世紀中期就已經發明了。但這種新裝置還是相當昂貴、不可靠。

「鬧鐘已經發明」是可以用的理由，But 後面說又貴又不可靠 → 本來可以用、實際上沒有用 → (B) could have used ✓

(A) must be using 一定正在用 (D) were mostly using 大多在用，都和「又貴又不可靠」矛盾。
eng113-16.k: could have p.p.＝本來可以…（實際上沒有）；下一句 But… 說鬧鐘又貴又不可靠。

eng113-17.stem: 17 sticks or pea shooters, the human alarms would tour the streets, tap on windows, or blast them with dried peas, trying to wake paying customers in time for work.

手上帶著工具 → (C) Equipped with 配備著 ✓

(B) Trained for 受訓做…（全國 15% 誤選）(A) Aimed at 瞄準 (D) Exhausted by 被…累壞。
eng113-17.k: Equipped with…＝配備著…；人肉鬧鐘拿著棍子或吹豆槍去敲窗戶。

eng113-18.stem: Whether they wielded rods or pea shooters, knockers-up became 18 throughout the United Kingdom.

隨處可見 → (A) familiar presences 熟悉的身影 ✓

(D) public eyesores 公共場所的礙眼之物（全國 32% 誤選）：文中說他們工作很專業，沒有負面的評價。

(B) distant memories 遙遠的記憶 (C) vague images 模糊的印象。

eng113-19.stem: While the practice continued in some parts of the country until the 1970s, it 19 as alarm clocks became more widespread and affordable.

句意：雖然這種做法在某些地區一直持續到 1970 年代，但隨著鬧鐘更普及、更便宜，它＿＿＿了。

eng113-19.k: 鬧鐘越來越普及、便宜 → 這個行業逐漸衰退（declined）。

eng113-20.stem: However, they cannot 20 the personal attention coming from the distinctive tap of a pea shooter.
eng113-20.ex:
句意：今天的鬧鐘和手機當然更簡單方便，但它們無法＿＿＿吹豆槍獨特的敲擊聲帶來的個人關照。

eng113-21.stem: The lonely “wind phone” serves to connect family members to their 21 loved ones who died in the tsunami that claimed 18,000 lives.
eng113-21.ex:
詞性分類：名詞 bridge、sorrow、hope、mechanism；動詞或片語 passed on、housed、brought forth；形容詞 departed、manageable、fateful。

句意：孤單的「風之電話」把家人和他們＿＿＿親人連在一起，這些親人死於奪走一萬八千條人命的海嘯。

eng113-21.k: their＿＿loved ones 中間要形容詞；departed（已故的）和後面 who died in the tsunami 呼應。

eng113-22.stem: People come to speak to those they have lost, to say the words they never got to say on that 22 day.

句意：人們來對失去的親人說話，說出那個＿＿＿日子裡一直沒機會說的話。

(C) sorrow 悲傷（全國 26% 誤選）：是名詞，不能直接修飾 day（要用形容詞 sorrowful）。
eng113-22.k: that＿＿day 要形容詞：fateful day＝決定命運（不幸）的那一天。

eng113-23.stem: The idea for the wind phone was first 23 by a Japanese garden designer named Itaru Sasaki, who was grieving over the death of his cousin in 2010, before the tsunami.
eng113-23.ex:
句意：風之電話的點子最早是由一位名叫佐佐木格的日本庭園設計師＿＿＿的。

(E) departed（全國 17% 誤選）(G) housed（全國 16% 誤選）放進去意思都不通。
eng113-23.k: The idea was first brought forth by…＝這個點子最早是由…提出的（被動語態）。

eng113-24.stem: Feeling that he needed a private space to help him navigate through the 24 , Sasaki positioned a booth where he could “speak” to the dead relative.
eng113-24.ex:
句意：他覺得需要一個私人的空間，幫助自己度過＿＿＿，於是設置了一座電話亭，讓他能和過世的親人「說話」。

eng113-26.stem: Sasaki stated in an interview: “Because my thoughts couldn’t be 26 through a regular phone line, I wanted them to be carried on the wind.”

句意：「因為我的思念無法透過一般的電話線＿＿＿，我希望讓風帶走它們。」

(E) departed（全國 12% 誤選）(J) brought forth（全國 12% 誤選）都不合句意。

eng113-27.stem: Hence, the wind phone allows Sasaki to create a one-way conversation with deep, soulful personal meaning, and renders the grieving process more 27 for him.
eng113-27.ex:
句意：風之電話讓佐佐木能進行一段深刻、單向的對話，使哀悼的過程對他來說更＿＿＿。

eng113-28.stem: News about the phone gradually spread, and the booth has become a 28 between the living and the dead.

eng113-28.k: a＿＿between A and B：電話亭成了生者與死者之間的「橋梁」。

eng113-29.stem: Grieving is a natural 29 for coping with loss of a loved one, and people grieve in various ways.
eng113-29.ex:
句意：哀悼是面對失去所愛之人的一種自然＿＿＿，每個人哀悼的方式都不同。

eng114-18.stem: Your brain doesn’t know whether you are stationary or moving when these parts send conflicting information: One part of your balance-sensing system detects that your body is moving, but the other parts 18 .
